newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: IMF to transfer $158 mln to Argentina in March.
newsitem.headline: IMF to transfer $158 mln to Argentina in March.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund has approved Argentina's economic objectives for fourth quarter 1996 and will transfer a $158 million standby loan tranche in March, said Finance Secretary Pablo Guidotti.
"The payment will be made official in the first week of March and the transfer will take place in the first half of March," Guidotti told journalists Wednesday.
Guidotti added that in March two officials from the IMF will visit Argentina "ahead of the official visit in April," to supervise the objectives for the first quarter of 1997.
Argentina's stand-by agreement with the IMF targets a $3.0 billion budget deficit for 1997 discluding the transfer of provincial pension liabilities to the central government.
The first-quarter target is a deficit of $1.04 billion.
